# Implementation Readiness Checklist: Hardware Library

**Purpose**: Gate the requirements before implementation begins. Tests whether the requirements themselves are complete, clear, consistent and measurable across four domains: deferred scope, data integrity, security and the process boundary, and agreement across the artifact set.
**Created**: 2026-09-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Deferred Scope and Traceability

- [ ] CHK001 Is the boundary between what ships and what is deferred stated in the spec itself, rather than only in plan.md and tasks.md? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the conditions that would unblock FR-029 and FR-030 stated precisely enough to recognise when they are met? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK003 Is FR-028 self-sufficient without FR-029 and FR-030, or does marking equipment approved mean nothing until enforcement exists? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK004 Do the requirements state what a person sees when equipment is marked approved but nothing enforces it? [Gap, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the dependency of FR-005a through FR-005e on a project file format recorded in the spec, or only in research? [Traceability, Spec §FR-005a]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the requirements that depend on deferred work distinguishable from those that do not, without reading plan.md? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK007 Is SC-012 achievable by anything shipping in this feature, given FR-005d and FR-005e are both deferred? [Conflict, Spec §SC-012]
- [ ] CHK008 Does the spec record that editing a type still rewrites what existing plans resolve until the deferred work lands? [Gap, ADR 0011]
- [ ] CHK009 Is there a requirement & acceptance criteria ID scheme that survives insertions, given FR-005a to FR-005e and FR-013a were added between existing numbers? [Traceability]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the withdrawal of SC-007 recorded where a reader of the spec alone would find it? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions]

## Data Integrity and Persistence

- [ ] CHK011 Is "an unreasonable number of ports" quantified, or left to implementation to choose a limit? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the requirements clear on whether the port limit applies per port group or per appliance type? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "damaged or partly written" defined well enough to be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements defined for what happens when the catalogue cannot be opened at all on start? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK015 Does the spec state which format versions FR-013a must be able to bring forward, or only that it must? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013a]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the requirements consistent on whether a file the application does not recognise is upgraded, imported partially, or both? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §FR-013a]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the skip reason required by FR-011 constrained to a defined set, or free text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for an import that collides with an entry the person has marked approved? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for importing a file that collides with itself, carrying the same identifier twice? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the behaviour specified when an import is cancelled partway through applying? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK021 Does the spec define what "everything needed to recreate the types elsewhere" includes, beyond symbols? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for the first-run migration of the 131 shipped types failing? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK023 Is it specified whether a person's edits to shipped types survive the migration described in FR-022? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the requirements measurable on what "searchable without loading all of it" means? [Measurability, Spec §FR-026]

## Security and the Process Boundary

- [ ] CHK025 Is the threat being defended against stated anywhere in the requirements, rather than deferred to a later decision? [Gap, ADR 0010]
- [ ] CHK026 Are the requirements clear on who "someone without permission" refers to, given the application has no accounts? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK027 Is it specified whether approving equipment is itself a restricted action? [Gap, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for approved equipment arriving through an import? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 Does the spec state the constraint that the renderer must not receive reusable filesystem paths, or is it only in the contract? [Traceability, Contracts §preload-bridge]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for what the renderer may do with a file the person chose, beyond the operation requested? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK031 Is symbol content constrained in the requirements, given an imported symbol is markup supplied from outside the application? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK032 Are size or complexity limits specified for an imported symbol or symbol set? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Consistency Across the Artifact Set

- [ ] CHK033 Do the spec, plan and tasks agree on which requirements are deferred, after five rounds of revision? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK034 Do the three wireframes and the requirements agree on what is drawn versus what ships? [Consistency, Spec §UI Mockup]
- [ ] CHK035 Does the data model account for every requirement added after it was written, including FR-005d, FR-005e and FR-013a? [Completeness, Data Model]
- [ ] CHK036 Does the bridge contract cover FR-005e, which acts across plans rather than on the catalogue? [Gap, Contracts §preload-bridge]
- [ ] CHK037 Are the ADR supersessions traceable from the spec, or only discoverable by reading the ADR index? [Traceability, ADR 0011, 0012, 0013]
- [ ] CHK038 Does quickstart.md cover a scenario for every user story and every non-deferred requirement group? [Coverage, Quickstart]
- [ ] CHK039 Are the assumptions in the spec still true after five revisions, particularly the one describing library ownership? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK040 Is any requirement now unreferenced by any task, as FR-019 was before it was caught? [Traceability, Tasks]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
